integrity: Exact formulas and all-parameter exclusions are supported by the written analytic proof; finite diagnostics independently probe the algebra, stationary equations and Hessian but do not prove universal claims. Prior demonstration of the Braess effect is credited and not asserted to be new.
scientific_limitations: Strict transverse linear stability of equilibria only in an alternating four-cycle with three equal edges and one strengthened edge. No assertions about nonlinear endpoint dynamics, basins, arbitrary weighted graphs, or nonstationary attractors.
title: Sharp algebraic all-weight locking threshold for an alternating four-cycle
